cohort: 179 women with a previous cesarean section undergoing labor induction
finding: While both balloon catheter and oxytocin induction appear safe for women with a previous cesarean section, oxytocin was associated with a higher rate of successful vaginal delivery, and balloon catheter had a disappointingly low success rate in the context of an unfavorable cervix.
mod_finding: Oxytocin induction was associated with a higher rate of successful vaginal delivery compared to balloon catheter.
